title: Barghsa Payments, Wallet and Refunds

panels.title: Overdue mandatory refunds
panels.description: Counts mandatory obligations outstanding for more than one hour.

panels.title: Wallets with critical drift
panels.description: Counts wallets whose balances and ledger differ at or above the configured critical threshold.

panels.title: Seconds since payment callback anomaly
panels.description: Shows time since the most recent callback rejection signal. An empty series has no observed anomaly.

targets.expr: time() - max without (instance, pod, callback, reason) (payment_callback_last_anomaly_timestamp_seconds > 0)

panels.title: Seconds since payment idempotency conflict
panels.description: Shows time since the most recent conflicting reuse of a payment idempotency key.

panels.title: Unresolved reconciliation cases
panels.description: Distinct cases awaiting or undergoing investigation. Includes cases below the critical wallet threshold.

panels.title: Firing financial alerts
panels.description: Active financial safety rules evaluated by Prometheus. Alert delivery is verified separately.

panels.title: Recorded payment outcomes in the last hour
panels.description: Distinct payment intents with a recorded terminal outcome. The most recent result for an intent is counted. Each scope uses the latest successful worker scrape.

targets.expr: sum by (environment, database, operation) ((finance_payment_outcomes_1h and on (environment, database, job, instance) topk by (environment, database) (1, timestamp(finance_activity_collection_success) and (finance_activity_collection_success == 1))))

panels.title: Payment success share in the last hour
panels.description: Completed outcomes divided by all recorded terminal outcomes for online top-ups and bank receipt reviews. Wallet invoice debits have a completion record only. Idle operations have no rate.

targets.expr: max by (environment, database, operation) ((finance_payment_outcomes_1h{outcome="completed",operation!="wallet_invoice_payment"} and on (environment, database, job, instance) topk by (environment, database) (1, timestamp(finance_activity_collection_success) and (finance_activity_collection_success == 1)))) / (sum by (environment, database, operation) ((finance_payment_outcomes_1h and on (environment, database, job, instance) topk by (environment, database) (1, timestamp(finance_activity_collection_success) and (finance_activity_collection_success == 1)))) > 0)

panels.title: Completed refunds in the last hour
panels.description: Distinct audited completions with a completed refund transaction, by destination.

targets.expr: max by (environment, database, destination) ((finance_refunds_completed_1h and on (environment, database, job, instance) topk by (environment, database) (1, timestamp(finance_activity_collection_success) and (finance_activity_collection_success == 1))))

panels.title: Refunded value in the last hour
panels.description: Sum of the durable amounts of the same completed refunds, in IRR.

targets.expr: max by (environment, database, destination) ((finance_refunds_completed_irr_1h and on (environment, database, job, instance) topk by (environment, database) (1, timestamp(finance_activity_collection_success) and (finance_activity_collection_success == 1))))

panels.title: Finance activity collection health
panels.description: 1 means the activity window was collected successfully. 0 means the collector could not read it. Existing safety gauges are collected independently.

description: Observed payment outcomes, completed refunds and financial reconciliation alerts.
